columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES chapters (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES chapters (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "extension_id" TEXT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "lang" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_rating" TEXT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "books" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id), "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "cover_url" TEXT NULL, "cover_local_path" TEXT NULL, "cover_updated_at" TEXT NULL, "series_name" TEXT NULL, "series_index" REAL NULL, "genres" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "language" TEXT NULL, "publisher" TEXT NULL, "published_date" TEXT NULL, "isbn" TEXT NULL, "abridged" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("abridged" IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NULL, "content_rating" TEXT NULL, "total_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "web_url" TEXT NULL, "in_library" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("in_library" IN (0, 1)), "date_added" TEXT NULL, "last_refreshed_at" TEXT NULL, "details_fetched" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("details_fetched" IN (0, 1)), "user_overrides" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "playback_speed" REAL NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "people" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_people" ("book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "person_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES people (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "person_id", "role"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chapters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "published_at" TEXT NULL, "is_listened" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_listened" IN (0, 1)), "listened_at" TEXT NULL, "last_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "removed_from_source" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("removed_from_source" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("book_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_files" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "format" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "duration_is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("duration_is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "size_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "embedded_markers" TEXT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NULL, "downloaded_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("book_id", "file_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chapter_segments" ("chapter_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_file_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_files (id), "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "end_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chapter_id", "ordinal"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "playback_states" ("book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "chapter_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters (id), "chapter_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "global_position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "listening_sessions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "chapter_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES chapters (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_global_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_global_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "speed" REAL NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "chapter_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES chapters (id), "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "flags" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "book_categories" ("book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("book_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extensions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_code" INTEGER NOT NULL, "api_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_handle" TEXT NULL, "origin_name" TEXT NULL, "install_path" TEXT NULL, "installed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extension_preferences" ("extension_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("extension_id", "key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "download_tasks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "media_file_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES media_files (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "hold" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bytes_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bytes_total" INTEGER NULL, "request_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "retry_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "transport_task_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("media_file_id"));
CREATE INDEX books_library ON books (in_library, date_added)
CREATE INDEX chapters_order ON chapters (book_id, source_index)
CREATE INDEX playback_states_recent ON playback_states (updated_at)
CREATE INDEX listening_sessions_started ON listening_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX download_tasks_pending ON download_tasks (state, priority)
